robot._connection_note: Motion uses the direct socket transport (transport.type=socket) to 127.0.0.1:5000; ROBOT_MONITOR frames go to monitor.port=5001. For the real robot set ip back to 192.168.0.10 and transport.type=plc.

monitor._source_note: Slice K robot monitoring config. Autostart is independent of ConnectionRobotButton.

ftp._note: The Winding_4600 RobotStudio station has no FTP server. Set enabled=false to simulate a successful upload (the MOD file stays local on the PC; the controller is expected to already have the .mod loaded separately, or LOAD_MOD is handled by SERVER.mod).

plc._connection_note: The Winding_4600 RobotStudio station has no S7-1200. With enabled=false the DB18 print handshake is simulated (always ACKed) and the DB5 laser/motor/cylinder controls are disabled. Set enabled=true and restore the real IP when running on the machine.

egm._note: 控制器 UCdevice(RemotePortNumber=6510) 会先向本机 6510 发 EgmRobot，本机解析后回发 protobuf EgmSensor。port 必须与 SIO.cfg 里的 RemotePortNumber 一致。

pressure._source_note: Defaults match Python: pressure_reader.py sleep(0.1), pressure_monitor.py 40-sample processing window.

high_speed_camera._source_note: Defaults match Python highspeed_camera_service.py and prefer a portable MVS SDK DLL beside the executable.

timeseries_archive._source_note: Optional new feature: start InfluxDB and archive pressure DDS samples to a time-series database.

grafana._source_note: Optional Grafana OSS server launcher for local pressure-data dashboards.
